text: The property experienced 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, which represents 2.23% of the total asset area. The loss occurred primarily in planted forests (68.1 ha), specifically *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*, with no native forest affected. An additional 13.2 ha of loss was outside mapped forest areas. The loss was confirmed by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference, which agreed on 98% of the affected area. Notably, 37.3 ha of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 ha, which were not counted as part of the event.
